receptionist.speaker: agent
receptionist.text: Thanks for calling Riverside Family Clinic — this is Ava. How can I help you today?

receptionist.speaker: caller
receptionist.text: Hi, I think I left my jacket in the waiting room after my appointment yesterday.

receptionist.speaker: agent
receptionist.text: Oh no! Let me check for you. Was it around 3 in the afternoon, with Dr. Lee?

receptionist.speaker: caller
receptionist.text: Yeah, that's right. It's a navy blue raincoat.

receptionist.speaker: agent
receptionist.text: Found it noted — I'll have the front desk set it aside under your name. Come by anytime we're open.

receptionist.speaker: caller
receptionist.text: That's such a relief. Thank you!

appointment.speaker: agent
appointment.text: Riverside Family Clinic, this is Ava. Would you like to book, reschedule, or confirm a visit?

appointment.speaker: caller
appointment.text: I need to move my Thursday appointment — something came up at work.

appointment.speaker: agent
appointment.text: No problem at all. I have Monday at 10, or Tuesday at 2:30. Which works better for you?

appointment.speaker: agent
appointment.text: You're all set for Tuesday at 2:30 with Dr. Lee. I'll text you a reminder the day before.

coordinator.speaker: agent
coordinator.text: Hi, this is Ava calling from Riverside Family Clinic about your visit next week. Do you have a quick minute?

coordinator.speaker: agent
coordinator.text: Wonderful. I just need to confirm a couple things — are you still taking any medications daily?

coordinator.speaker: caller
coordinator.text: Just my blood pressure tablet, ten milligrams.

coordinator.speaker: agent
coordinator.text: Perfect, I've noted that. Please remember to fast for eight hours before your blood test. Okay?

coordinator.speaker: caller
coordinator.text: Got it. I'll see you next week.

refills.speaker: agent
refills.text: Riverside Family Clinic, this is Ava. I can help with a prescription refill — what do you need?

refills.speaker: caller
refills.text: I'm nearly out of my inhaler and I need a refill before the weekend.

refills.speaker: agent
refills.text: I can take care of that. I'll send it to your pharmacy on Fifth Street — is that still the right one?

refills.speaker: agent
refills.text: Great — it'll be ready for pickup this afternoon. Is there anything else I can help with?
